name: Nessle · Gremlet #50
description:
A shy lake monster that pops up wherever there's a puddle. Blurry in every photo.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Nessle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
